The expiry date is December of this year

The product in question is a one-litre pre-packaged milk "Junlebao Pure Milk", imported by "Junlebao (Hong Kong) International Trading Co., Ltd.", with an expiry date in December this year. The Centre for Food Safety stated that milk samples taken from the relevant batch for testing showed that four of the samples contained ten or more bacterial colonies, exceeding the standard set out in the Milk Industry Regulations. A spokesperson said that the bacterial colony count exceeding the legal standard indicates that the hygiene condition of the product is less than ideal, but does not mean it will cause food poisoning.

It has not entered the market

The Centre for Food Safety stated that it will continue to follow up on the incident, pointing out that investigations revealed the affected batch remains in the importer's warehouse and has not entered the market. The Centre has notified the importer of the violation and will temporarily revoke the import permit previously issued to the importer for the sale of this product. Other similar products of the same brand currently sold in the market are not affected.

Application for listing in Hong Kong

According to information, Junlebao Dairy was established in 1995 and was once a company under Sanlu Milk Powder. After Sanlu's melamine incident in 2008, it separated from Sanlu and was once acquired by Mengniu, before becoming independent again in 2019. The company announced in 2016 that it would enter the Hong Kong market with infant formula under the principle of "same quality, same price in mainland China and Hong Kong". It submitted its first application for a Main Board listing to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in January this year, and re-submitted updated forms at the end of last month. According to prospectus information, Junlebao produces and sells dairy products under its parent brand "Junlebao", as well as brands such as "Jian Chun" and "Yue Xian Huo". Based on 2025 China market retail sales, it ranks third among national dairy product companies.
